data.body:
STATUS at handoff — J7 is UNBLOCKED (J6 9fd4 closed certified) and its plan review is RUNNING.

The plan on this ticket was CORRECTED earlier this session against merged origin/main, because it
was written before J6 executed and J6 delivered more than it anticipated. Read the correction
comment above before implementing. In short:

ALREADY DONE by J6 (do NOT re-do):
 * adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py EXISTS (JiraDataCenterBackend, the @register factory,
   _search_users_by_username);
 * adapters/__init__.py already imports it, so select_backend("jira-datacenter") resolves.

STILL GENUINELY MISSING (verified against the merged tree, not assumed):
 1. _config_schema.py's reconciler.backend validator is STILL `_as_choice(v, k, {"jira"})`. The DC
    backend is REGISTERED BUT UNREACHABLE: the registry resolves it, config rejects it. This is
    the core of J7.
 2. test_backend_contract.py's fixture is STILL params=["fake", "jira"] — the DC backend has never
    been run against a single generic port assertion. Note FakeTransport lacks probe_remote, which
    the backend delegates; check whether it suffices before adding a rival fake.
 3. The J2 import checker rejects adapters/jira/ importing adapters/jira_datacenter/, but has NO
    rule for the other direction — a DC module importing adapters/jira/ passes today. That
    reciprocal half is this story's AC and is genuinely absent.
 4. _optionality.yml's clean-core-wheel absent-module list still lacks "jira" (line ~108).

PATH NOTE: the live test file belongs at tests/external/live_jira_dc/, NOT tests/live_jira_dc/.
Outside tests/external/ it is collected by per-commit CI on runners with no Docker or Jira and
breaks the build for everyone.

LIVE-TIER LESSON from J6, worth reusing: a live module must FAIL LOUDLY, not skip, when the
harness is reachable but the [jira-datacenter] extra is absent. The all-skip canary counts
collected-vs-executed GLOBALLY per session, so a sibling module's executing tests mask an
all-skip and the job reports green having validated nothing. J6 shipped two defects behind exactly
that mask.
